# apple_subscription (Resource)

Manages an auto-renewable subscription in a subscription group. Set its customer-facing names with `apple_subscription_localization`, and submit it with `apple_submit_subscription`. Product IDs can't be reused, even after deletion. Destroying the resource deletes a subscription that was never approved; an approved one stays. Import it by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_subscription" "monthly" {
  subscription_group_id = apple_subscription_group.pro.id
  product_id            = "com.example.pro.monthly"
  name                  = "Pro Monthly"
  period                = "ONE_MONTH"
  group_level           = 2
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Reference name, seen only in App Store Connect; up to 64 characters.
- `period` (String) Length of a subscription period: `ONE_WEEK`, `ONE_MONTH`, `TWO_MONTHS`, `THREE_MONTHS`, `SIX_MONTHS`, `ONE_YEAR`.
- `product_id` (String) Product ID the app uses in StoreKit, e.g. `com.example.pro.monthly`. It can't be reused.
- `subscription_group_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the subscription group, e.g. `apple_subscription_group.example.id`.

### Optional

- `family_sharable` (Boolean) Whether family members can use the subscription. Once on, it can't be turned off. Defaults to `false`.
- `group_level` (Number) Rank of the subscription in its group, from 1 for the highest level of service. Customers who move to a higher level upgrade at once. Defaults to the next level.
- `review_note` (String) Notes for App Review, up to 4,000 characters.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the subscription.
- `state` (String) State of the subscription, e.g. `MISSING_METADATA`, `READY_TO_SUBMIT` or `APPROVED`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_subscription.monthly
  identity = {
    id = "6446452616"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the subscription.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_subscription.monthly 6446452616
```
